reason: Exploratory record kept as an audit trail. It was produced before the false-positive relief term was made self-consistent in |G| (src/gems/emission.py::fp_relief): it assumed a constant 0.813, which is only correct at |G| ~ 125,000 - the value this record's own analysis went on to refute. At the measured |G| (5,564-14,944) the relief is ~0.985, so every implied |G|, TP and skill number here is ~20% low. Do not cite. Current equivalents: docs/data/live-model-bounds.json, docs/data/habitat-model.json, docs/data/offline-proxy-audit.json.
